items.title: AMD falls on short-seller report of alleged China exposure
items.description: AMD was slumping Wednesday after a short-seller alleged that its firmware showed up at blacklisted Chinese company

items.title: Big bets against AI debt, from CoreWeave to Oracle and the Mag 7, could soon hit the ETF market
items.description: Investor fears about AI balance sheets and debt are running high, especially for neoclouds. ETFs targeting the credit default swaps of AI issuers are coming.

items.title: Anthropic IPO: Investors who flip the stock may face brokerage penalty
items.description: Brokerage firms may put future IPO limits in place for investors who sell their Anthropic stake too soon.

items.title: Gold's bad year is getting worse. Why its price keeps falling
items.description: Gold has fallen sharply from its January record as higher interest rates and a stronger dollar change the investment case for the precious metal.

items.title: Palo Alto stock jumps on earnings beat and company's big bet on securing open-weight models
items.description: Palo Alto Networks reported better-than-expected first-quarter results and inked a $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute

items.title: Trump, Xi, Putin said they plan to boost oil production, revamp UN after trilateral talks
items.description: The leaders of the U.S., China and Russia met in Shenzhen, China on Thursday for a rare trilateral gathering.

items.title: Amazon launches in-app push against Mamdani-backed delivery bill in New York City
items.description: Amazon has lobbied heavily against the proposed legislation, while New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani backed the bill earlier this year.

items.title: Anthropic IPO, AI wealth spawn a new, leaner kind of family office
items.description: The Anthropic IPO and a flood of AI wealth are spurring the creation of new family offices built for the era of artificial intelligence.

items.title: We're buying 1 non-tech stock and 1 tech stock as the market tips oversold
items.description: It's time to put money to work because the S&P Short Range Oscillator has finally moved into oversold territory.

items.title: Kash Patel skips House hearing after Mar-a-Lago gala with $50,000 access
items.description: Kash Patel missed a congressional hearing after appearing the night before at a Mar-a-Lago gala offering donors of $50,000 access to top officials.

items.title: Walmart hikes outlook as CEO tells CNBC retailer aims to keep prices low despite soaring fuel costs
items.description: Walmart said it saw strength with store-fulfilled pickup and delivery in its fiscal third quarter.

items.title: Family offices move more money into stocks, hedge AI risk, according to CNBC Family Office Portfolio Tracker
items.description: Family offices continued to boost their stock holdings, but they hedged the AI trade with financials, according to the CNBC Family Office Portfolio Tracker.

items.title: Nvidia interim CEO Kress tells employees ‘let’s move forward’ at first all-hands meeting since Jensen Huang exit
items.description: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress urges staff forward and offers pay raises after Jensen Huang exit.

items.title: Denmark ratifies Trump security deal over Greenland after months of diplomatic tensions
items.description: It follows months of tensions after President Donald Trump repeatedly said the U.S. should take control of Greenland for national security reasons.

items.title: Data center electricity use could double by 2030, IEA says
items.description: Global electricity use by data centers could double by 2030 as the AI boom adds pressure to power grids across the world, according to the IEA.

items.title: APEC final day in photos: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands; Takaichi kept at a distance
items.description: Leaders gathered Thursday for the second day of the economic summit, ahead of a historic trilateral meeting between the U.S., Russia and China.

items.title: Novartis raises blockbuster drug forecasts to $18 billion as it seeks to prove growth can last
items.description: The drugmaker cited strong demand for its blockbuster drugs as it upgraded peak sales forecasts for multiple sclerosis, leukemia, and cholesterol medicines.

items.title: Trump praises ‘great relationship’ with Putin after meeting, as Ukraine war takes center stage
items.description: U.S. President Donald Trump met individually on Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin, as well as Chinese President Xi Jinping.

items.title: Takaichi gets chilly reception in China on first Japan leader visit since 2019
items.description: Takaichi received a subdued welcome on her trip to attend the APEC summit, as Beijing shows limited appetite for repairing ties strained by Taiwan dispute.

items.title: Musk accuses Zelenskyy of lying about Starshield restrictions in Ukraine
items.description: Elon Musk was asked about Zelenskyy claims over the Starshield network, and he said, "I don't want to blow your mind, but Zelenskyy is not always truthful."
